title: Sidebar hide under a pointer on the left edge, then the edge reveal (Lawrence msg 29542: the hidden sidebar floated back; the top-row buttons jumped). Before: the float comes back after the hide. After: it stays hidden until the pointer leaves the edge and returns; the toggle, Back and Forward leave with the sidebar. The edge steps pair the real pointer move with debug.mouse hover: AppKit derives tracking-area crossings from window-server motion, which the capture driver's cursor warp does not make, so without the hover the edge zone never sees the pointer leave or return (DebugHover). Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/sidebar-hide-edge-reveal.json --video

steps.title: Sidebar shown: the top row's even gaps
The pointer on the sidebar, at the window's left edge
Hide the sidebar with the pointer still on the edge
After the hide: the sidebar must stay hidden (Before: it floats back)
debug.mouse hover learns the pointer is on the edge: the zone read it when it was placed, and hover sends a leave only to the views it entered
Its tracking areas see it leave (the edge rearms)
The pointer returns to the edge
Its tracking area sees it enter: after the 100 ms intent delay the float slides in on the drawer curve
